subject: Q4 renewal: performance audit & flexible burst lane request
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@windward.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@windward.ai
Date: 2025-10-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Q4 renewal — spike in token spend + latency samples attached

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for the recent check-ins. As we approach our renewal next month, the ops team flagged a few items we need to resolve before we sign the amendment:  

- Token spend jumped ~42% MoM in September after launching a generative summarization flow.
- We see an intermittent 95th percentile latency increase (from ~220ms to ~420ms) during peak windows (US east, 11:00–14:00 PT).
- We need a short-term surge/burst lane or credits while we finalize model optimizations.

I attached our Q3 performance snapshot and a short CSV with raw latency samples. Can your team run a quick audit to confirm whether this is routing/concurrency or model-side? Also, we want to discuss a one-quarter amendment to add flexible burst capacity and a small commit uplift tied to usage.

Attachments: performance_report_Q3.pdf (pdf), latency_samples.csv (csv)

Proposed next steps:
1) Quick triage call (30m) this week to align on root cause.
2) Temporary burst lane (credits + routing guardrails) during remediation.
3) Amendment with 10–15% commit uplift conditional on performance SLA.

Can you confirm availability Wednesday–Friday?

Thanks,
Elena Park
Head of Infrastructure
Windward AI

---
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@windward.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-10-02T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Q4 renewal — spike in token spend + latency samples attached

Elena — thanks for the clear detail and attachments. Appreciate the triage artifacts.

High level response: we can absolutely support a short-term burst lane and make a one-quarter amendment for a committed uplift while your engineering team stabilizes the model. Before we lock terms, we'll run a quick root-cause triage. My ask for the call:

- Access to a sample of request IDs and a few KV cache traces (we can take off-line samples — please redact PII).
- Confirmation of which model variant / tokenizer is in use for the summarization flow.
- Approx expected peak TPS during the window you surfaced.

Proposed times:
- Wed 2025-10-03 09:00–09:30 PT
- Wed 2025-10-03 13:30–14:00 PT
- Thu 2025-10-04 11:00–11:30 PT

On the commercial side (cc'ing Kimberly): preliminary commitments we can consider:
- One-off burst credits to cover the immediate overage, plus temporary routing to dedicated burst pools.
- A 90-day amendment with a 12% commit uplift and a rollback clause if average consumption drops below current baseline in that quarter.

I'll kick off an internal log request and drop a short checklist to Windward to expedite the triage.

Logs link: https://drive.google.com/perf-q3 (request contains instructions).
HubSpot: 0034567

Thanks — I can take Wed 9am PT.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-10-03T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Windward amendment framing and commercial levers

Internal note (do not forward as-is to customer).

Quick commercial framing for the call with Windward:

1) Offer structure we can sign off on today (legal and finance pre-cleared):
   - 90-day amendment (WD-AMEND-90) adding a tiered burst lane: first 250k tokens free as credit, additional burst usage billed at 50% discount off standard overage rate.
   - Commit uplift of 12% for the quarter; standard renewal rates hold.
   - Performance SLA addendum: if 95p latency > 400ms for >4 consecutive business hours, they get an additional 5% credit on that quarter's invoice.

2) Operational / delivery notes:
   - Routing: move peak traffic to our dedicated burst pool during their window (requires firewall rule for their IP blocks).
   - Guardrails: token throttles at the tenant level + automatic fallback to smaller context model when latency threshold triggers.

3) Ask for OSS evidence: they should ship the anonymized request IDs + 30 minutes of KV traces (redacted). We'll run a root-cause runbook and present findings within 48 hours.

If legal needs to change wording, we'll route an addendum template (I have one ready). For pricing, finance prefers credit + discount vs. a pure refund approach — cleaner for ARR math.

Next steps: Mateo to confirm call time and get access artifacts from Elena. I'll draft the amendment and route to legal for a quick review.

Kimberly Park
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
